title: ticfac factory deploy exits 0 when the deploy failed
description:
On 2026-09-20 two consecutive factory deploys failed with a hard Cloudflare API error and  exited 0 both times:

    ERROR  A request to the Cloudflare API (.../workers/scripts/ticks-factory) failed.
    Cannot create binding for class 'RepoRoom' ... [code: 10061]
    [exited with code 0]

I only knew they had failed because I read the output. Anything that scripts a deploy records a failed deploy as a successful release - including .github/workflows/deploy-factory.yml, which exists precisely so there is ONE deploy path and which gates nothing else on the exit status.

The wrangler child process's status is being dropped. Whatever the deploy's own post-checks do, a non-zero wrangler must make the command non-zero.

Same defect shape as atn (a test that fails without saying why) and udu (a refresh that can never work reporting as a note): the system knows the answer and does not put it in the channel anyone checks. A release pipeline is the worst possible place for it.

While fixing, check the other direction too: the deploy prints 'Factory ready' and a version id on success, so a caller has something to assert on; make sure a partial failure cannot print that line.
acceptance_criteria: A factory deploy whose wrangler invocation fails exits non-zero and does not print the ready banner, proven by a test with a wrangler stub that fails
